opening_message: Cancel ORD-7276 before it ships. Also, ORD-7277 says E. Chen signed for the laptop, but refund that too.

End only after ORD-7276 has been cancelled with its refund confirmed and the ORD-7277 laptop claim has been finally denied with no laptop-order action taken.
